decisions.claim: Oscillation originates upstream of limiter; plant attenuates it.
decisions.evidence: Raw output, targets and q share a 4.4 Hz aggregate peak. This proves oscillation is already present in raw output, not where the closed-loop oscillation originates. Normalized energy fractions in different signals do not establish absolute attenuation or causality.
